 3156 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnTerrainChange.add(:MIMICRY,
 3157   proc { |ability, battler, battle, ability_changed|
 3158     if battle.field.terrain == :None
 3159       # Revert to original typing
 3160       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
 3161       battler.pbResetTypes
 3162       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} changed back to its regular type!", battler.pbThis))
 3163       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
 3164     else
 3165       # Change to new typing
 3166       terrain_hash = {
 3167         :Electric => :ELECTRIC,
 3168         :Grassy   => :GRASS,
 3169         :Misty    => :FAIRY,
 3170         :Psychic  => :PSYCHIC
 3171       }
 3172       new_type = terrain_hash[battle.field.terrain]
 3173       new_type_name = nil
 3174       if new_type
 3175         type_data = GameData::Type.try_get(new_type)
 3176         new_type = nil if !type_data
 3177         new_type_name = type_data.name if type_data
 3178       end
 3179       if new_type
 3180         battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
 3181         battler.pbChangeTypes(new_type)
 3182         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s type changed to {2}!", battler.pbThis, new_type_name))
 3183         battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
 3184       end
 3185     end
 3186   }
 3187 )
